# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. It defines the workflow (clarify → design → plan → build in small verified steps → test, including E2E for UIs → self-review → finish) and the core rules: verify with real checks, never invent library APIs, prefer boring well-maintained stacks, keep secrets out of source, and ship something that runs.

Task-specific procedures are in `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`; open the relevant one when its topic comes up.
